def transform(grid):
    """Intersect nonzero cells in the panels above and below the solid divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    assert len(top) == len(bottom)
    assert all(len(row) == w for row in top + bottom)
    result = [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
               for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(top))]
    # The demonstration confirms that the operation is cellwise AND, recolored 2.
    assert result == [[2 if x and y else 0 for x, y in zip(a, b)]
                      for a, b in zip(top, bottom)]
    return result
